job.name: ig29_host
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary man (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
job.meaning: ведущий ~33: короткая стрижка, аккуратная светлая борода, джинсовая рубашка, светлая кухня-шоурум с деревянными досками
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of an energetic, likeable Russian man about 33 with short light-brown hair and a neat short beard, a light-blue denim shirt with sleeves rolled up, standing behind a light kitchen counter. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, medium shot from the waist up, both shoulders inside the frame, face large and sharp, top of head about 16% below the upper edge, looking straight into the lens, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, NO smile. Background: a bright modern kitchen showroom with several handmade wooden cutting boards of different woods standing on open shelves, soft daylight, blurred. Look: a real frame from a high-end camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark.
